pages.title: Tap Out Puzzle
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Tap Out Puzzle asks you to dismantle three-dimensional shapes one block at a time. Check the arrow on a block before you tap it. The block can only leave in that direction, so you may need to clear another piece out of its way first. Drag to look around the structure and find the blocks with room to move. Keep uncovering new paths until the shape is gone.

pages.title: Tap-Hold
pages.creator: Pavel Beke
pages.description: Tap-Hold sends you flying through a neon obstacle course. Hold the mouse button, touch the screen or hold Space to climb. Release to descend. Adjust how long you press as the next barrier approaches, and use the same motion to reach coins and power-ups along the route. Unlock more characters and see how far you can carry the next flight.

pages.title: Mission Santa: Deliver the Gifts
pages.creator: Garry'sGems
pages.description: Mission Santa: Deliver the Gifts puts you in Santa's sleigh. Click, tap or press Space to drop presents as you fly past rooftops. Time each drop so the gift falls into a chimney. Harder deliveries are worth more points, and landing several in a row builds a combo. Set new records to unlock more gifts for later runs.

pages.title: Backrooms
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description:
Backrooms traps you in a maze of unsettling rooms and corridors. Look for keys, repair circuits and solve puzzles to open escape routes between levels. The entities that roam the maze can hunt you down, so be ready to hide or run when one approaches.

You can investigate alone or join friends online. Proximity voice chat lets you speak with teammates when they are nearby, so staying close can help you coordinate as you search the maze together.

pages.title: Tied Up
pages.creator: Dissorto
pages.description:
Tied Up gives you control of a small ball connected to a larger one by a spring. Guide the small ball with the mouse and use the swing of the larger ball to evade or counter approaching enemies. The spring carries momentum through a turn, so watch where both balls are moving.

Each run gives you three lives. Survive as many waves as you can and see how high a score you reach before the last life is gone.

pages.title: Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds
pages.creator: Low Pixel Byte
pages.description: In Arrow Survival: 15 Seconds, an archer has to last fifteen seconds in each pixel art stage. Dodge hazards and fire arrows when you have an opening. Move with A and D or the left and right arrows, jump with W, Up or Space, and shoot with J or X. There are 40 levels to work through, and R restarts the current one.

pages.title: Jelly Math 3D
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Jelly Math 3D asks you to drag jelly numbers into place to make correct equations. Solve problems with addition, subtraction, multiplication or division, and try puzzles involving shapes and logic. Choose a timed challenge when you want to work against the clock or switch to relaxed play. As you progress, you can unlock more jelly characters and themes.

pages.title: Color Wavee
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Color Wavee is a reflex game about steering a ball that keeps moving. Press and release to guide it around the other moving balls without making contact. Watch their paths before changing your input, since they can move across the space you were about to use. Keep the run going by finding a way through each encounter.

pages.title: Stickman Gun Shooter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Gun Shooter gives you a rotating gun and a level full of yellow stickman targets. Wait for the gun to turn toward a target before you take a shot. Obstacles make some shots harder to line up, and the stickmen react with ragdoll physics when hit. Use a mouse or touch input to shoot as you work through the different setups.

pages.title: Merge Flowers
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: In Merge Flowers, new flowers arrive at the bottom of the screen for you to plant on the board. Place them by color to make rows of at least three matching flowers. Clearing a row earns coins and opens space for the next plants. The garden expands as you advance, giving you more room to work with and more flowers to discover.

pages.title: From Nerds to Beauties
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: From Nerds to Beauties follows the Little Mermaid and Arlene through a two-stage makeover. Start with the cosmetic and hair care activities for both friends. Then move to the wardrobe and choose hairstyles, clothes and accessories for their new looks. You can give the two characters different styles by changing the combinations you use in the dress-up stage.

pages.title: Stack Fall
pages.creator: MOVISOFT.Co.,Ltd
pages.description: Stack Fall has you drop a bouncing ball through layers of platforms. Touch the screen to smash through the floors below it, but time the drop to avoid the black sections. A hit on black ends the attempt during normal play. Build up the gauge to enter a powered mode that lets the ball break through without stopping.

pages.title: Tsunami Race
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Tsunami Race gives you three ways to compete. In the main race, keep moving to stay in front of a giant wave while trying to beat the other runners. In Fruit Run, dodge pieces of fruit flying across your path. Water Slides moves the race onto slides, where you can knock rivals aside and pick up boosters. Choose a character before entering the mode you want to play.

pages.title: Screw Puzzle Master
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description:
Screw Puzzle Master asks you to take apart assemblies of wooden pieces held together by bolts. Move the bolts so the wood can fall away, thinking about where you can put each one before you free it. The order matters because each move changes which pieces are still held in place.

Work through the chapters, use power-ups when a layout has you stuck, and try different skins as you progress.

pages.title: Hide and Escape from Angry Teacher
pages.creator: Eccentric Games Studio
pages.description: In Hide and Escape from Angry Teacher, you play a student trying to get out of school. Move through the building, hide when teachers are nearby, and interact with objects that might help you avoid being spotted. Your destination is the school bus. Keep track of the teachers as you find a route from your hiding place to the exit.

pages.title: Just Dice - Random Tower Defence
pages.creator: Flying Swan Games Limited
pages.description: In Just Dice - Random Tower Defence, dice are towers that attack waves of monsters. Place towers on the map and check the dots on each die to see its power level. Combine two towers showing the same number of dots to make a stronger one. Decide which pairs to merge as you build up enough firepower to hold off the next wave.

pages.title: From Zombie to Glam A Spooky Transformation
pages.creator: CGSpot
pages.description: From Zombie to Glam A Spooky Transformation follows Ellie as she changes her look from undead to ready for Halloween. Work through the makeover in stages, including cleaning her hands, applying makeup and decorating her nails. The final stage opens the wardrobe, where you can choose an outfit to go with the colors and details you picked earlier.

pages.title: Snake 2048.io
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Snake 2048.io turns a growing snake into a chain of numbered cubes. Steer through the arena to collect cubes at or below your current value, then combine numbers to make your snake bigger. Power-ups are scattered around the arena, and you can boost to cover ground more quickly. Use the mouse, Left and Right arrows or A and D to steer. Click or press Space to boost.

pages.title: Xmas Float Connect 2023
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Xmas Float Connect 2023 asks you to clear a board by linking pairs of matching holiday tiles. Choose two with a clear path between them that takes at most two right-angle turns. On some levels the remaining tiles shift or split when you remove a pair, so check the new layout before choosing your next match. There are 27 boards to clear, with a bonus for finishing within the time limit.

pages.title: IDLE Animal Anatomy
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description: IDLE Animal Anatomy lets you assemble an animal cell by cell. Add cells and watch the model take shape in the middle of the screen as bones, organs and skin develop. You can earn cells by clicking or let them accumulate over time. Spend resources on upgrades to increase production, then use the new cells to continue building your animal.

pages.title: Merge Items
pages.creator: Dorfer Games OU
pages.description: Merge Items has you build a city by combining materials. Merge what you have to make the items needed for construction, then use them to develop and upgrade the city. As the metropolis grows, keep track of the materials that go into each new project so you can make the supplies your next building needs.

pages.title: Rainbow Friends Jetpack
pages.creator: Vally Games
pages.description: Rainbow Friends Jetpack sends a character of your choice through stages filled with monsters and traps. Fight the enemies you encounter and collect coins to improve your weapons or upgrade your Rainbow Friend. Pick up lucky blocks and look for secret boxes as you progress. Their prizes and character unlocks give you more options for later stages.

pages.title: 2K Shoot
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: 2K Shoot combines bubble shooting with the number merges of 2048. Aim and fire a ball at another of the same color and value. The pair turns into one ball worth twice as much, which you can match again when a suitable shot comes up. Look at the available angles as well as the numbers to set up higher merges.

pages.title: Rainbow Girls Halloween Salon
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Rainbow Girls Halloween Salon puts you in charge of costumes for Skyler, Sunny, Ruby and Violet. Browse the Rainbow High friends' wardrobe and put together a Halloween look for each of them. Choose a mask to go with the outfit, using different combinations to give each girl her own take on the party's spooky theme.

pages.title: Tank War Defense
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Tank War Defense pits your tank against aircraft attacking from above. Shoot down each plane while getting out of the way of the shells it fires. Keep watching the sky as the next attacker arrives. The final plane is tougher than the earlier ones, so you will need to survive its fire as well as land your own shots.

pages.title: Euro School Driving Coach 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Euro School Driving Coach 3D puts you behind the wheel of a school bus on hilly routes. Your job is to get the students home on time. Drive through climbs and descents while dealing with conditions such as rain, snow and thunderstorms. Watch the road as it changes and keep the bus moving toward its destination.

pages.title: Ice Fishing
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description:
Ice Fishing lets you choose a fishing spot and bait before dropping a line. Keep an eye on the float and wait for a bite before pulling, then work the rod to bring the fish in. The timing of the pull matters as much as your choice of bait.

Each fish you catch earns money. Spend it on different bait or a new rod, then try another location and see what you can land there.

pages.title: Bombs Drops Physics balls
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Bombs Drops Physics balls gives you a field of numbered blocks and a batch of balls to drop from above. Choose where to release them so they bounce through the field and strike several targets. Each hit takes one off a block's counter, and the block bursts at zero. Aim for routes that also reach bonuses as you work to clear each level.

pages.title: Wonderful High Heels 3D
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: Wonderful High Heels 3D sends you along obstacle courses in a pair of heels. Build up their height as you go so your character can get over taller barriers. Later levels change the route and make the obstacles harder to cross. Finishing a course earns rewards you can spend on items before trying the next one.

pages.title: Jugar Snake
pages.creator: pyxel and soft
pages.description: Jugar Snake brings the classic phone game to the browser. Use the arrow keys to turn the snake and guide it toward the food. Each piece you collect adds to the snake's length, leaving less open space for later turns. Keep track of where the tail is as you steer toward the next piece.

pages.title: Knife Jump
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Knife Jump has you flip a knife through a course of objects you can slice. Tap to turn the blade over and time the next flip as it approaches another obstacle. Watch where the blade is headed between taps so you can bring it through the objects in its path.

pages.title: Rac Simulator
pages.creator: GameL
pages.description: Rac Simulator lets you take a sports car out on open city streets. Explore different cities at your own pace or take on driving missions for a specific objective. There is no need to beat a rival across the map. You can use the streets to get used to the car before heading to your next mission.

pages.title: Arctic jump
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Arctic jump challenges you to build a tower under your character one block at a time. Jump so the next block lands beneath you, then repeat from your new perch to climb higher. The timing gets important when you want the stack to keep growing. Complete challenges to unlock five bonus animals to take up the tower.

pages.title: Sliding Ball
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Sliding Ball has you keep a ball safe on a single horizontal track. The ball can travel left or right, but it cannot leave the line when shapes begin falling toward it. Watch where each shape is about to reach the track and move the ball away from that spot before they meet.

pages.title: Princess Devil Transformationd
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Princess Devil Transformationd follows a princess who takes on a devil form after an encounter at a bus stop. Help her put together a look for the transformation. Start with devil-themed makeup, then go shopping and choose clothes for the final outfit. The makeup and wardrobe stages let you decide how the change will look.

pages.title: Food Empire Inc
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Food Empire Inc starts you with a farm in the sky. Tap the workers to grow crops, send the harvest down in an elevator, then move it to the warehouse to earn money. Spend coins on upgrades and hire managers to run parts of the operation for you.

As the business grows, you can open more sky farms and grow crops from lettuce and strawberries to tomatoes and ginseng. Your farms can earn while you are away, and attracting investors gives you a way to cash out.

pages.title: Brick Breaker Endless
pages.creator: Dumadu Games Pvt Ltd
pages.description: Brick Breaker Endless lets you fire balls from a cannon at a field of neon bricks. Set up an angled shot to strike several bricks in one volley, and aim for power-ups when you have an opening. Keep breaking bricks before they reach the bottom. The longer you keep them back, the more chances you have to improve your score.

pages.title: Redhead Knight
pages.creator: JM Neto Game Dev
pages.description: Redhead Knight follows Arthur, a young knight on a quest to restore peace to his village. Guide him through side-scrolling levels where enemies stand between him and the way forward. The journey spans 15 stages across three worlds. Get Arthur past the obstacles and enemies in each area to continue toward the end of his quest.

pages.title: Scratch & Guess Animals
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Scratch & Guess Animals shows you an animal picture hidden beneath a scratch card. Rub away enough of the cover to spot a clue, then try to name the animal. The scratch meter tracks how much you reveal, so start with a small patch and see whether an ear, stripe or other feature is enough to make a guess.

pages.title: Drunken Table Wars
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Drunken Table Wars turns tug of war into a fight over a table. Pull the table toward your side and try to drag your opponent with it. Objects can land on the table during the struggle and change how the round goes. Play against the computer or another player, and take five rounds to win the match.

pages.title: Super Bike Wild Race
pages.creator: Barnzmu
pages.description: Super Bike Wild Race puts you on a motorcycle in races across 3D circuits. Compete against other riders and learn where each track asks you to slow down or change direction. Between races, develop both the bike and the rider. Upgrading their performance gives you another way to improve alongside learning the courses.

pages.title: Water Car Stunt Racing
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Water Car Stunt Racing puts you in a car on courses that cross water. Drive with the arrow keys and follow the route as it takes you between the dry sections and the water. Each course has a time limit and a finish point, so keep the car moving as you steer through the course.

pages.title: Animals Jigsaw Puzzle Horses
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Animals Jigsaw Puzzle Horses gives you eight horse pictures to reassemble. Pick a picture and choose a grid of 2 by 3, 3 by 4 or 4 by 6 pieces. Drag each piece to where it belongs, comparing the shapes and details in the image as you work. Try a larger grid when you want more pieces to sort.

pages.title: Smash Cars!
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Smash Cars! puts you on a driving course where getting there quickly takes knowing when to stop. Move the car forward when the track is clear, then hold back as a hazard comes across the route. Wait for an opening and continue through the course, using the gaps between obstacles to reach the finish.

pages.title: Coloring Heroes
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Coloring Heroes lets you pick a drawing of a Marvel hero and color it your way. Choose the shades you want for the character's costume and the rest of the picture. You can follow the hero's familiar colors or try a different palette and see how it changes the drawing.

pages.title: Jungle 5 Diffs
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Jungle 5 Diffs presents two nearly identical cartoons in each of its 20 levels. Compare corresponding parts of the pictures and select the five details that have changed. Check the smaller objects if the obvious differences are already marked. A hint is available when you have trouble finding one of the remaining changes.

pages.title: Around The World With Jumping
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Around The World With Jumping asks you to leap over the Eiffel Tower as Earth rotates beneath you. Watch how fast the tower is approaching before you jump. The rotation speed changes, so the timing that cleared the tower last time may be wrong on the next pass. Hitting it ends the run.

pages.title: Terrorist Attack
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Terrorist Attack is an arcade shooter set in a city under attack. Find the armed opponents on screen and use the mouse to aim and fire at them. Press R to reload your gun. Keep track of where the threats appear so you can aim at the next one as you defend the city.

pages.title: Color and Decorate Christmas
pages.creator: IG
pages.description: Color and Decorate Christmas gives you four holiday drawings to color. Choose a picture, then apply your colors to the different areas of its design. Once you have colored it, add Christmas stickers to decorate the scene. The stickers let you give two versions of the same picture a different look.

pages.title: Ink Inc.
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Ink Inc. puts you behind the tattoo tool and gives you a design to draw. Guide the tool along the pattern and try to keep your lines steady, especially where the shape changes direction. Pay attention to the outline as you work from one part of the drawing to the next.

pages.title: Wood Cutter Santa Idle
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Wood Cutter Santa Idle takes Santa into a fairy forest to chop down a Christmas tree. Click to swing and earn money, then spend it to unlock an elf helper and improve their chopping. Upgrades change the speed and power of the axes. Keep cutting and developing the pair as you work toward the achievement rewards.

pages.title: Christmas 2019 Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Christmas 2019 Differences sets two holiday pictures side by side and gives you a limited time to find the details that differ. Look between the same areas of both pictures and mark each change you spot. Finishing sooner earns a higher score, and the Hint button can help when one difference is holding you up.

pages.title: Chained Impossible Driving Police Cars
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Chained Impossible Driving Police Cars puts your driving to the test with two vehicles linked by a chain. Use WASD to steer your car and account for the other vehicle's movement as you head toward the finish. Turns can pull the cars apart, so watch the gap between them to avoid breaking the link. Choose between Chase and Survival modes to take on different courses.

pages.title: Baby Doll House Cleaning Game
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Baby Doll House Cleaning Game gives you a series of messy rooms to tidy before time runs out. Use the mouse to work through the clutter and clean up dirt and stains with the available tools. Watch the countdown while you finish the room. Once it is clean, move on to another part of the house.

pages.title: ZombieCraft 2
pages.creator: AngryGamez
pages.description: ZombieCraft 2 is an adventure RPG where you choose a character and fight groups of zombies. Equip an axe, a sword or another available item before heading into the fight. The goal for advancing is to defeat 50 zombies. Keep track of your kills as you clear the current level and make your way to the next one.

pages.title: Offroad Vehicles Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Offroad Vehicles Puzzle contains six jigsaw pictures of Benz off-road vehicles. Choose an image and rebuild it with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. On the larger puzzles, a tire, grille or stretch of bodywork may be spread across several pieces, so compare those details as well as the outline when you look for a fit.

pages.title: Professor Bubble
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Professor Bubble is a color matching shooter. Aim a bubble so it joins a group of the same color, and make matches of three or more to clear bubbles and score. Look at where the next shot can add to an existing group, then keep finding matches to raise your score.

pages.title: Rope Around
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Rope Around asks you to route a rope past a set of stakes. Take it around the board so it touches every stake while keeping the rope clear of obstacles. Look at how a turn changes the whole path before heading for another stake. Each layout gives you a different route to work out.

pages.title: Kikker Puzzle
pages.creator: WPG Kindermedia
pages.description: Kikker Puzzle lets you assemble illustrations of Kikker and his friends from the stories by Max Velthuijs. Choose an available picture and fit the pieces together on an easy or hard setting. Collect butterflies as you play to open more illustrations, then try putting together a scene you have just unlocked.

pages.title: Tattoo Salon
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Tattoo Salon lets you pick a model and choose where to place a tattoo, including the arm, back, waist or neck. Apply a stencil, then work over the design with the tattoo machine and choose ink colors. You can also remove a tattoo and try a different design on the model.

pages.title: Ice Cream Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Ice Cream Memory shows you an ice cream order for only a few seconds. Study the picture while it is visible, then use the available choices to recreate it from memory. The clock gives you a limited time to finish. Pay attention to how the ice cream is put together before the reference disappears.

pages.title: Horse Riding Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Horse Riding Simulator casts you as a cowboy facing waves of zombies. Ride through the area on horseback and use the available weapons to fight back. The arsenal includes a bow and a sword, giving you a way to fight at range or deal with enemies up close. Keep an eye on the zombies as they close in around the horse.

pages.title: Blocky Blast
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Blocky Blast asks you to find groups of neighboring blocks with the same color. Select a block that touches at least one other block of its color to make a match. A block on its own cannot make a group, so compare adjacent pieces as you look for your next move.

pages.title: After Homecoming Party
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: After Homecoming Party gives you three college friends to style for their celebration. Help Belle, Eliza and Elena choose dresses and accessories before they welcome former students back to campus. Try a different look for each friend, changing the accessories as you go to see what works with each dress.

pages.title: Breakout Pixel
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Breakout Pixel takes the brick-breaking idea of Breakout and puts a bouncing pixel in play. Keep returning the pixel so it strikes the bricks above, then work on reaching the ones left after the first few hits. Aim to clear the layout by keeping the pixel moving between the bottom of the screen and the brick field.

pages.title: Lucky Block Tower
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Lucky Block Tower challenges you to build as high as you can by dropping one block onto another. Click or tap to release a block when it lines up with the stack below. Every placement gives you the base for the next drop, so watch the alignment as the tower grows.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Brain Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Brain Doctor puts you in charge of a cartoon hospital scene with Dotted Girl as the patient. Use the tools provided by the game to work through the operation and remove the odd objects you discover. Follow the sequence on screen to finish caring for the superhero.

pages.title: Ahoy Pirates Adventure Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Ahoy Pirates Adventure Game sends you through a maze to collect gold coins while sentries patrol the paths. Guide the pirate around the guards and pick up every coin. A saber and TNT give you ways to deal with sentries when they get in your way. Plan your route around their positions as you collect the remaining gold.

pages.title: Ellie Vaccines Injection
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ellie Vaccines Injection takes place in a cartoon doctor's office where Ellie is getting her yearly vaccines. Guide her through the game's appointment, starting with water and vitamins before using the supplies shown on screen. After the first shot, continue to the next one and finish the visit so Ellie can go home.

pages.title: Casual Soccer
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description: Casual Soccer is a one-touch goal-scoring challenge. Use the single input to take your shot and try to get the ball into the net. Each goal adds to your total, so focus on the timing of the next kick as you try to beat the number you scored on an earlier attempt.

pages.title: Amazon Warrior Wonder Woman Dress Up
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Amazon Warrior Wonder Woman Dress Up gives you a wardrobe for preparing Diana for her final battle. Choose the pieces of her outfit and see how they look together on the Amazon warrior. You can change the combination as you go until you have the battle look you want for Wonder Woman.

pages.title: Barbara Beauty Tips
pages.creator: Play Belle Games
pages.description: Barbara Beauty Tips has you help Barbara get ready for a Friday night party. Start with the game's beauty treatment, mixing the flowers in the container to make a cream for her makeover. Then move to makeup and clothing in the fashion boutique. Put together a look that suits the party, whether you choose a princess style or something more casual.

pages.title: Fashion Show
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: In Fashion Show, Elsa and Rapunzel need outfits for their first show as fashion models. Pick clothes for each of them and put together two looks for the event. You can try different combinations for each model before deciding what you want the pair to wear for their debut.

pages.title: Rope Ninja
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Rope Ninja sends a ninja across gaps by catching passing birds with a rope. Press and hold to throw the rope and pull toward a bird, then release to let go and aim for the next platform. The timing of the release determines where you land. Keep making crossings to see how far you can get.
